description: PRISM scheduled cron jobs registry. Each entry names a script + cron expression; the cron-bootstrap loader translates to platform scheduler.

jobs.description: Compose 3-connections + 1-pattern + 1-question brief from inbox/memories/wiki-log; written to knowledge/memories/inbox/brief-YYYY-MM-DD.md.

Walk H:/Resources/ for new/touched files (mtime > last-scan-ts); emit one inbox marker per file at knowledge/memories/inbox/resources-<slug>-<sha>-<date>.md. Batch capped at 5000 files; first cold run completes <300s, steady-state <60s. State at mcp-server/data/state/resources-weekly-scan.json.

Promote high-confidence tribal tip clusters (confidence >= 60, cluster_size >= 3) to knowledge/memories/reference/tribal-<topic>-YYYY-WW.md. Idempotent on ISO-week. Surfaces tribal knowledge as reference material for /weekly-synthesis to incorporate. Deterministic template synthesis (no LLM round-trip).

Render the cyrilXBT JARVIS feedback-loop monthly report (4 questions: topics-by-BPI, hook outperformance, untried angles, double-down combos) from knowledge/memories/published/ into knowledge/memories/inbox/perf-report-YYYY-MM.md. Calls performanceLoopEngine.monthlyReport(). 1st-of-month at 08:01 local gives prior month a clean publish-date floor.

Archive (cp + unlink) inbox/*.md files older than 48h to knowledge/memories/inbox/archived-stale/. Honors cyrilXBT 'inbox is for triage not storage' rule but softer than delete. Idempotent (already-archived files are skipped). Brief/perf-report files exempt.
